verdicts.reason: A puts the plan cards in the wrong order (6, 80, 48), so the highlighted Yearly card is out of sequence. The subtitle under the logo and the fine print under the headline are far too small to read, and the three middle clusters feel crowded. B keeps the original card order (6/48/80) and reads left to right, but the CTA pill takes almost half the width and outweighs the small headline. The logo is tiny, the cards are squeezed, and the fine print is unreadable.
